title: London road disruptions (TfL)

provenance.by: sources/tfl-road-disruptions/collect.mjs (code, no model; run by data.b@PrompTugal.dinis)
provenance.terms: TfL's Transport Data Service terms (based on the Open Government Licence v2.0 with TfL amendments): free to copy, publish, distribute, transmit and adapt the information and to exploit it commercially and non-commercially; credit "Powered by TfL Open Data"; at most 500 calls a minute per feed; no implied endorsement.

about: Works, incidents and closures on London's roads as Transport for London listed them at the read: severity, category, place, TfL's description and the period. Collected once a day as the archive; the page shows the live list read in your browser from TfL.

live.how: the page asks TfL for this address when it opens; TfL allows browser reads (CORS *)
